notes: ACCESS: Tier (a) HTTP (curl_cffi, chrome124 impersonation) reached robots.txt/sitemap fine (no anthropic/claude-specific disallow; generic 'User-agent: *' disallows only query-string/search/cart paths) but every category page returned an Akamai 'Access Denied' edge block (403) or a JS behavioral-sensor challenge page - confirmed on homepage and /storage-baskets/. Tier (b) Playwright (headless chromium) also hit the same Akamai 'Access Denied' 403 wall. Escalated to tier (c) Claude-in-Chrome: a real Chrome tab cleared the Akamai behavioral challenge automatically and loaded the site normally, so all data below was gathered via mcp__claude-in-chrome (navigate + get_page_text) on a single shared tab, batched. TREE: built from the full mega-menu (read_page interactive dump on homepage, all nav columns) plus each category page's own left sub-nav strip (several nodes, e.g. Hinged/Bench Cushions, Pot Holders & Oven Mitts, Mattress Protection & Bed Skirts, Kids' Bedding, Kids'/Garage Storage, Cabinet & Pantry/Food Storage/Utensil Holders/Kitchen Drawer Organizers, were only discoverable this way, not in the top mega-menu). QTY: exact 'NNN items' / 'Showing 1-N of N Items' text from each category page's own product-count header (confirmed h1/title matched the requested node on every page). EXCLUDED: View-All/Collection/Search/Clearance/Sale pages; all curtain-rod/hardware/hook pages (curtain-rods-hardware, bath-hardware, over-door-hooks, toilet-paper-holders); non-textile Kitchen & Dining items (dinnerware, cookware, trash cans); purely decorative items (vases, trays, planters); Storage Product Sets and Trash Cans (bundled/non-storage); Beach Towels (URL silently redirects to the generic '/bed-bath-seasonal/' Seasonal collection page, not its own category - excluded per collection-page rule). DUPLICATES RESOLVED: /storage-bins/ redirects to /storage-baskets/ (same 549-item page) so 'Bins' was dropped as a nav label with no separate URL; /bed-pillows/ (Pillows menu) and /bed-pillows-protectors/ (Bed&Bath menu) are the identical 41-item product list under two URLs - kept once as 'Bed Pillows & Protectors' under Bedding; /throwpillows/ (Bed&Bath menu 'Throw Pillows' link) actually resolves to the generic /pillows/ landing page (no product grid) so it was not treated as a distinct leaf (the real Throw Pillows count is already captured via /toss-pillows/); /bathroom-storage-organization/ redirects to the /bathroom-organization/ group landing page (no product grid - its real children Bathroom Counter & Makeup Organizers / Shower Caddies & Totes / Bathroom Shelves,Carts & Storage are already captured individually); /office-desk-organizers/ redirects to the same /office-organization/ page (105 items) already captured once. LOW/MEDIUM confidence flags: Shower Curtains & Accessories (224) and Dorm Bath (129) mix genuine textile with non-textile hardware/accessories (shower rods+hooks, toilet paper holders, trash cans, mirrors) under one combined count with no way to isolate the textile-only subset from the page; Napkins & Napkin Rings, Utensil Holders & Caddies, Hangers & Closet Accessories, Garage Storage similarly combine the named textile/storage product with a minority of adjacent non-textile/non-storage items on the same listing page. Washable Rugs, Dorm Rugs, Dorm Bedding, Seasonal/Halloween/Fall Pillows & Throws are genuine standalone site navigation categories with their own URL/H1 but their product sets visibly overlap with the primary Rugs/Pillows/Bedding categories already recorded (confirmed via shared product titles and type-facet breakdowns) - kept per-page exact counts since each is a real distinct listing page, flagged MEDIUM.
